name: Compact pointer tree
aliases: Hierarchical Voxel Compression with Wavelet Transform
definition: A tree-based data structure for volumetric RGBA data where internal nodes store N^3 children (N=2 to 6), minimum/average/maximum color attributes, and 8-bit offsets to 32-bit addresses. It enables interactive visualization of terabyte-scale data by compressing color values using wavelet transforms and allowing on-demand voxel reconstruction.
summary: The Compact Pointer Tree is a tree-based data structure for interactive visualization of terabyte-scale volumetric data, distinguished by its variable branching factor and wavelet-based color compression.
